event: Nala kneels at the stumps and threads her braid down between the roots, toward the blight.

changes.note: Nala threads a braid down into the burrow

memory.fact: The last kiln jackalope lies curled an arm's length down its burrow; a hand can reach it.

event: The lash finds the jackalope in the dark. The pull strand bites. Under the roots, it goes still.

changes.note: Killing the last kiln jackalope earns Nala experience

event: She reaches into the burrow and drags it out by the hind legs. A small blightstone lies under it.

memory.fact: Nala's braid killed the last kiln jackalope in its burrow; a small blightstone lay under it.

event: She collects all three small blightstones and walks back up the south road toward town.
Her well fills a little on the way.

event: At the Post, Marda looks up from the ledger as Nala lays the three stones on the desk.
Marda turns them over one by one. Each is part-pale. Her brows go up.

memory.fact: Seeing Nala's three part-pale blightstones, Marda's brows rose; she asked 'Where'd these come from?'

event: "Silver apiece," she says, and counts three silver into Nala's hand.
